sources.title: Pioneer DDJ-SX2 Operating Instructions, pages17–18 (manufacturer document, retailer mirror)
sources.provenance: Manufacturer-authored historical manual, retrieved from retailer mirror. Not current installed-version runtime evidence.

documented: Eight slices per domain; domain sizes2/4/8/16/32/64beats and quantization1/8,1/4,1/2,1.
Shifting Slicer advances its domain; Slicer Loop repeats a fixed domain.
Manufacturer manual specifies quantization as a fraction of the assigned section and release to the underlying rhythmic position; a beatgrid is required.
limits: Device docs corroborate feature mechanics; no DDJ-SX2/Rane hardware test or exact Serato4.0.10 combined warped/keyed runtime equivalence. Physical Slicer-to-Stems mapping is separate.
